answer_1.quote: We consider 11 different languages (including English) for 3 different tasks ... intent recognition, topic classification, and sentiment analysis.

answer_2.quote: We compute two metrics: The cosine similarity of TF-IDF ... and the cosine similarity of embeddings ... We also evaluated n-gram diversity of the gold and generated training samples.

answer_3.quote: We use an LLM to revise and filter out "bad examples" by prompting with the intent description and previously generated samples.

answer_4.quote: Another limitation of this work is the lack of human annotations for checking the quality of the generated data. Involving human annotators was not feasible...
